subject: Handoff: Nimbus Systems - onboarding & runbook request
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbussystems.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Handoff: Nimbus Systems - onboarding & runbook request

Hi team,

Quick handoff for Nimbus (closed-won yesterday). High-level context: 12-month Dedicated contract, 4x reserved GPUs, target go-live for pilot ingestion on 2026-09-20. Customer will start with real-time chat + embeddings for internal KB search. Key constraints: SOC2 evidence required, they want IP allowlist and VPC peering in us-west-2, and they asked for token-level cost alerts during the first 30 days.

Attach: NIMBUS-SOW-v1.pdf (signed) and nimbus-initial-mop.xlsx (kickoff checklist).

Asks for CS/Implementation:
- Owner assigned for sprint0 and go-live (we need a primary steward and a tech lead).
- Draft runbook: network allowlist steps, key rotation cadence, and acceptance criteria for the pilot.
- Intake call window: they asked for next-week availability (preferred mornings PT).

Internal notes for owners: budgeted for up to two on-site discovery days if needed (T&E approved). Sales has committed a two-week overlap from contract signature to start of sprint0.

Ben — can you own the stewardship? Marissa, please nominate the implementation engineer. Karthik, flag any capacity risk if this clashes with Q3 ramp.

Thanks,

Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: NIMBUS-SOW-v1.pdf, nimbus-initial-mop.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbussystems.com>
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Nimbus Systems - onboarding & runbook request

Thanks Vanessa — taking stewardship.

Quick plan from my side:
1) Assign primary: Ben Carter (Steward) — overall delivery and customer liaison.
2) Tech lead: Marissa Cole (Implementation Lead) — responsible for runbook, network ops, and staging tests.
3) Security/compliance POC: Karthik Iyer — will validate SOC2 evidence and assist with KMS/HSM requirements.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Wed 2026-08-05 10:30 PT: internal 30-min sync (Ben + Marissa + Karthik + Vanessa) to review MOP and outstanding contract clauses.
- Thu 2026-08-06 09:00 PT: kickoff with Nimbus (Laura + ops@nimbussystems.com) — 60m for discovery and environments.

Marissa — can you confirm you can take the Tech Lead role and review the attached MOP? I’ll start a draft runbook based on our onboarding template and link it to Confluence.

Notes: billing will start on contract effective date 2026-08-01 but pilot acceptance criteria must be met for full feature enablement. Customer asked for a discrete SLA for chat latency (p95 < 300ms) for the pilot window — we should capture this in the runbook.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Head of Customer Success — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
(Referenced: https://confluence.redwood/team/onboarding-templates/Nimbus-Runbook)

From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbussystems.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@nimbussystems.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 12:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Nimbus Systems - onboarding & runbook request

Hi Ben / Vanessa — thanks for the quick handoff. Confirming availability for Thu 2026-08-06 09:00 PT for the kickoff — that works for our team.

A few clarifications from our side to include in the runbook:
- Environment: staging cluster will be in our us-west-2 account; we'll provide a read-only role for Redwood.
- Data: first ingest will be 150k documents (PDFs + text). We plan to test incremental syncs.
- Security: we will need a signed SOC2 Type II attestation and an IP allowlist template before peering.
- Success metrics: pilot acceptance defined as (a) ingest completed and searchable; (b) chat rubric pass rate >= 85% on our internal eval set; (c) p95 latency under 350ms for the pilot workload.

I'll loop in our ops inbox (ops@nimbussystems.com) on calendar invites. We'll upload network CIDRs and staging credentials to the secure folder after the kickoff.

Look forward to the kickoff.

Best,

Laura Chen
Head of Product Operations
Nimbus Systems
(Attachment: none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@nimbussystems.com>
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Handoff: Nimbus Systems - onboarding & runbook request

Thanks — I can take Tech Lead. I reviewed the MOP and flagged three immediate risks in the sheet:
- Network CIDR overlap with our default staging VPC (needs mapping)
- KMS integration: customer prefers their KMS in us-west-2; we need to confirm HSM compatibility (Karthik, can you advise on keys/rotation cadence?)
- Pilot scale: 150k docs will likely need increased batch size for vectorization to meet the latency target — I'll propose a quantization + batch plan in the draft runbook.

I'll create the initial runbook draft by EOD Wed 2026-08-04 and share the Confluence link. For the kickoff agenda I suggest: intros, environment/credentials, acceptance criteria, immediate blockers, and timeline for sprint0 tasks.

Ben — please send the calendar invites for the internal sync and the external kickoff (include ops@nimbussystems.com). Vanessa — flag if you want to join the kickoff.

Marissa Cole
Principal Implementation Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachment: nimbus-initial-mop.xlsx — annotated)
